description: This file provides API service functions for fetching recipe data, either from a REST API endpoint specified by environment variables or from local sample data. It exports functions to retrieve all recipes and a specific recipe by ID.

methods.name: getRecipes()
methods.description: Fetches all recipes, attempting to use a REST API endpoint if configured, otherwise falls back to local sample data.

methods.name: getRecipeById(id)
methods.description: Fetches a single recipe by ID, attempting to use the REST API if configured, otherwise searches the local sample data.
